initialization: Current small MLP checkpoint; one scorer only, no H.
fitting: Existing 5216 fitting datasets only; no assessment labels in gradient updates. Original training g values remain out-of-fold.
target: On original fitting rows only, a fixed mixture of the true irrelevance label and original F predicted irrelevance; added fitting rows use true labels.
hard_weight: Upweight rows with any of the eight saved IPSS q measurements <= .5, renormalize within dataset, then enforce the specified original/new total masses.
preprocessing: Unchanged training-only sign-log scaling saved with the existing MLP.
checkpoint_data: 500 deterministic, equally spaced draws from the previously examined 2500 standard tests, plus the existing 1360 broad/easier/harder validation draws. These are development data.
guards: At .05,.10,.20, standard TPR >= 98% of original screened F; each nonnull group and each null source mean FDR <= alpha+.02; broad/easier/harder group TPR >= 95% of current screened MLP.
objective: Maximize equally weighted harder-synthetic/harder-real-predictor TPR over .05,.10,.20 among feasible checkpoints; improve this objective by at least 0.005 over current screened MLP.
final_check: All 9310 old regression draws and unchanged appendix designs; freeze one feasible candidate before generating fresh confirmation seeds. No publication on validation performance alone.
gate: Unchanged ten-IPSS union at the current target; no target or simulator labels enter F.
